SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: Supreme creator god who establishes cosmic order through combat with chaos, embodies civilized power and divine kingship
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The hero-king who defeats primordial chaos and creates ordered reality

DevelopmentalArc: Young God → Champion Selection → Combat with Chaos → Creation from Slain Enemy → Establishment of Order → Supreme Kingship

MythicAppearances: Creation of heaven and earth from Tiamat's body
CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Supreme deity of Babylonian state religion, New Year festival rituals, royal legitimation, creation liturgies
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Rose to supremacy during Old Babylonian period (Hammurabi era), absorbed attributes of older gods especially Enlil, remained supreme throughout Babylonian history

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Standing victorious over chaos dragon (Tiamat), wielding four winds, holding Tablet of Destinies, accompanied by Mushhushshu dragon, horned crown
ArtisticExamples: Cylinder seals showing combat with Tiamat
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: I am the wind that shatters chaos, the hand that shapes cosmos from the slain dragon, the king who establishes what shall be.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: Standing victorious over a slain serpent of chaos, creating ordered reality from its body; ascending to a throne of absolute authority

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoke for establishing order from chaos, heroic victory, leadership, creation of new structures
AIPromptSeeds: Generate a hero who defeats primordial chaos and creates ordered reality from the enemy's body.
Create a king whose sovereignty comes from victory over the fundamental forces of disorder.
NarrativeHooks: Champion chosen to face impossible chaos
Slaying the dragon and creating the world
Rising from young god to supreme king
